props.name: onCheckedChange
props.description: Called with the new checked state whenever it changes.

props.name: indeterminate
props.description: Show the mixed state (a dash). It clears as soon as the user clicks.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Stops the user from changing the checkbox.

props.name: label
props.description: Visible label shown next to the checkbox.

props.name: description
props.description: Smaller helper text shown under the label.

props.name: name
props.description: When set, a hidden input is rendered so the value posts with a form.

props.name: value
props.description: Value posted with the form when checked. Used with name.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Required when there is no visible label.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes added to the outer element.
